revision.note: Drop 7: top elbow of the vertical leg

name: Leg top elbow and flanged outlet
function: The elbow block on top of each leg that turns the flow from vertical to horizontal and carries the flanged outlet toward that well's tree.

tabs.overview: A studded block elbow with a flanged outlet spool; the flanged treating spools to the inlet block bolt on here. A pressure transducer port sits on top of the block.
tabs.safety: Outlet lines are restrained and inside the red zone.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.
